title: Brand variant adaptors and dark-mode token bridge for Console components
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Scope: Define a deterministic token mapping layer that bridges our semantic design tokens to multiple brand variants (Redwood default, Redwood-dark, and Partner-Blue) and produce component-level overrides for buttons, tables, and charts. The token bridge should enable runtime theme switches with no visual jank, preserve accessibility contrast targets, and make it straightforward for platform engineers to onboard new partner themes. Deliverables: token bridge spec, token mapping CSV/JSON, Storybook + visual regression snapshots for three brand themes, Figma token library updates, and a rollout plan with canary flag. This work focuses on component surface area most affected by theming: button states (primary/secondary/ghost/disabled), table row/row-hover/border treatments, and chart color ramps/axis/tooltip styling. We will prefer semantic tokens (surface/interactive/outline/overlay/critical/positive) and map them to brand palettes rather than baking brand colors into each component implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A token mapping document (JSON + human-readable CSV) exists that shows semantic token -> brand token mappings for all tokens used by Button, Table, and Chart components
Storybook stories for Button/Table/Chart render correctly in Redwood-default, Redwood-dark, and Partner-Blue themes with visual snapshots passing regression tests
All theme variants meet WCAG AA for regular text and 3.0:1 for UI components where applicable; accessible focus rings are present and review notes resolved
Component overrides are implemented as a minimal adapter layer (no per-component branching in most cases) and a documented fallback policy for missing mappings
Migration notes and a canary rollout plan with feature-flagged release and smoke test checklist are documented and linked
Design tokens updated in Figma library and exported to token JSON schema used by the build system
engineering_notes: Prefer CSS custom properties for runtime switching with a small JS adapter to set root token values per theme
Provide generated token JSON for each brand variant and a canonical semantic token set (semantic tokens should be the source of truth)
Charts should receive color ramps via tokens (chart.series.1..N) and support both discrete palettes and gradient ramps for area/line fills
Tables: support a pair of surface tokens for zebra/striped rows and an explicit token for row divider; avoid relying on box-shadow for row separation in compact mode
Buttons: keep three levels (primary/secondary/ghost) driven by semantic tokens (button.bg, button.fg, button.border, button.hover.bg, focus-ring) and add a brandAccent token that partners can map to
Fallback policy: if brand token missing, fall back to semantic token -> neutral scale mapping and log a runtime warning in dev mode
Performance: ensure token switch is O(1) writes to :root; avoid re-rendering entire component tree where possible (use CSS variables instead of inline styles)
